**Changelog for v1.0.2 — huawei-cloud-smn-dms-message**

- Added scripts/ensure_cli.sh and scripts/install_cli.sh for automatic installation and verification of skill-quality-cli, ensuring quality telemetry.
- Updated workflow: all skill actions now require skill-quality-cli; this is enforced automatically and idempotently on every execution.
- Expanded/consolidated trigger keywords and tags for DMS/Kafka/RabbitMQ/RocketMQ/SMN actions.
- Improved documentation in SKILL.md: outlined new supply chain security checks and quality CLI requirements, detailed script usage, and added clear telemetry opt-out instructions.
- Removed skill-card.md; all relevant usage, risks, and action details are now consolidated in SKILL.md.
- Code and documentation adjusted to enforce PATH updates and secure dependency installation.

huawei-cloud-smn-dms-message v1.0.1

- Initial release supporting management of Huawei Cloud SMN (Simple Message Notification) topics, subscriptions, message templates, and message publishing.
- Provides 15 actions to query, diagnose, manage, and perform destructive operations for SMN and DMS (Kafka/RabbitMQ/RocketMQ) services.
- Guides users on prerequisites, authentication, and safe command execution with risk-based workflow (auto-run, confirm, or require explicit approval).
- Supports both AK/SK and hcloud profile authentication.
- Includes clear triggers for relevant operations and strictly enforces credential security policies.
